hooks.command: CMD=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(s);console.log((d.tool_input||d).command||'')}catch{console.log('')}})" 2>/dev/null || true); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'prisma migrate (reset|dev).*--force'; then echo '[HOOK] 🛑 BLOCKED: prisma migrate reset/dev --force on remote DB wipes all data. Use migrate:deploy for safe migrations. To override: set ALLOW_REMOTE_RESET=true in env. See apps/backend/scripts/prisma-migrate-guard.js' >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$CMD" in *grep*|*rg\ *|*ripgrep*|*find\ *|*fd\ *|*ack\ *|*ag\ *) [ -f graphify-out/graph.json ] && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"graphify: Knowledge graph exists. Read graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md for god nodes and community structure before searching raw files."}}' || true ;; esac

FP=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{console.log((JSON.parse(s).tool_input||{}).file_path||'')}catch{console.log('')}})" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$FP" in *.example|*.sample) exit 0 ;; *.env|*.env.*) echo "[hook] BLOCKED: $FP holds secrets. Edit env files manually, never via the agent (prevents secret exposure + accidental commit)." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

FP=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{console.log((JSON.parse(s).tool_input||{}).file_path||'')}catch{console.log('')}})" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$FP" in *schema.prisma|*migrations/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"Prisma edit (Neon/PgBouncer): additive-only + IF NOT EXISTS; mirror every raw-SQL index with an @@index in schema (avoid drift); materialized views need DROP+CREATE to redefine; CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto before digest(); never Promise.all over writes inside one $transaction.  ⛔ NEVER run prisma migrate reset or migrate dev --force on remote DB — wipes all data. Use migrate:deploy."}}' ;; esac

FP=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{console.log((JSON.parse(s).tool_input||{}).file_path||'')}catch{console.log('')}})" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$FP" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.json|*.md|*.css) npx prettier --write "$FP" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true ;; esac

CMD=$(node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>s+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(s);console.log((d.tool_input||d).command||'')}catch{console.log('')}})" 2>/dev/null || true); case "$CMD" in *graphify\ update*) node scripts/graphify-to-vault.js >&2 || true ;; esac
cd apps/backend && npx tsc --noEmit --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile node_modules/.cache/tsc-hook.tsbuildinfo 2>&1 | head -30 || true
